name: Bee house
about: Two beehives under a little roof, with flowers all around for the bees.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Dig a short path at the front and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Posts and flowers
layers.tip: Put up two log posts, three blocks apart. Plant flowers all around: bees need flowers to make honey.

layers.name: Beehives
layers.tip: A log on each post, then a beehive, a plank and a beehive between them. Turn the beehives to face the front.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the row with birch slabs, and one more row behind it. Hold a flower and bees will follow you.
